Build an EPID -> admin-value reference (most-recent-per-EPID)

Source: R/spatial.R
build_admin_ref.Rd

For each EPID, takes the most recent non-blank value of admin_col (ties broken deterministically). Used to fill missing admin values from other records that share the exact same EPID.

Usage

build_admin_ref(data, admin_col, epid_var = "epid", year_var = "year")

Arguments

data

Data frame containing epid_var, year_var, and admin_col.

admin_col

Name of the admin column to summarise.

epid_var

EPID column name. Default "epid".

year_var

Recency column name. Default "year".

Value

A tibble with columns epid_var and admin_col, one row per EPID.

Examples

cases <- tibble::tibble(
  epid = c("A-1", "A-1", "B-2"),
  year = c(2023, 2024, 2024),
  district = c(NA, "BOSSO", "LUANDA")
)
build_admin_ref(cases, "district")
#> # A tibble: 2 × 2
#>   epid  district
#>   <chr> <chr>   
#> 1 A-1   BOSSO   
#> 2 B-2   LUANDA
